## Verifier: **pass**

All eight acceptance checks ran against the built production app (`npm ci` → `npm run build` → `npm run start -- --port 3000`, Chromium via Playwright CLI). Evidence in `/tmp/gh-aw/agent/bsf/media/`.

| \# | Check | Result | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | No query → five invoices + All/Draft/Sent/Paid/Void links | pass | `check1-all-no-query.png` |
| 2 | Draft → only INV-1004 | pass | `check2-draft-via-click.png` |
| 3 | Paid → INV-1001, INV-1003 | pass | `check-paid.png` |
| 4 | Sent → INV-1002; Void → INV-1005 | pass | `check-sent.png`, `check-void.png` |
| 5 | Paid anchor `aria-current="page"` + weight 700, others 400 | pass | `check5-paid-selected.png` |
| 6 | `?status=bogus` → all five, All selected | pass | `check6-bogus-status.png` |
| 7 | Export unaffected by filter | pass | `check7-draft-export-button.png`, `check7-download.csv` |
| 8 | Build 0 + `/invoices` dynamic; test/typecheck/lint 0 | pass | `check8-build.txt` |

### Notes on how each was exercised

**Check 2** was done by *clicking* the Draft link, not by loading the URL, so Next `Link` client navigation is covered. Resulting URL `?status=draft`, table body one row.

**Check 5** was verified beyond the served HTML: `getComputedStyle` in the live browser returns `700` for Paid and `400` for All/Draft/Sent/Void, with `aria-current="page"` present on Paid only.

**Check 7** is the strongest result. On `/invoices?status=draft` the button reads `Export 3 invoices as CSV` (not 1). Clicking it downloaded `invoices-2026-11-21.csv` containing the header plus INV-1001, INV-1002, INV-1003 — INV-1004 and INV-1005 absent. I then downloaded again with no filter and the two files are **byte-identical** (md5 `c7e8cd524fb1a1c6b398f33fd8597148`). `curl -i /invoices/export` still returns 200, `text/csv; charset=utf-8`, `attachment; filename="invoices.csv"`, `no-store`.

**Check 8**: build exits 0 and the route table shows `ƒ /invoices` (Dynamic), the predicted consequence of reading `searchParams`. 43 tests pass across 5 files; `typecheck` and `lint` both exit 0.

### Ways I tried to break it

All returned HTTP 200 and fell back to the All view with the All anchor selected — no error, no empty table:

`?status=` · `?status=draft&status=paid` (repeated param) · `?status=DRAFT` · `?status=Draft` · `?status=%20draft` · `?STATUS=draft` · `?status[]=draft`

And these behaved correctly: `?status=draft#x` (filters to INV-1004), `?foo=1&status=void` (filters to INV-1005, unrelated param ignored), clicking the already-selected link a second time, reloading a filtered page, browser back/forward across Paid→Void, and returning to All from a filtered state. The export button label stayed `Export 3 invoices as CSV` through every one. Console: 0 errors after navigation — no hydration warnings. The only console error seen all session was a pre-existing `favicon.ico` 404 on first load, unrelated to this change. Server log clean.

`Total sent: $1,497.50` is unchanged under every filter. That is correct and not a regression: it was computed from the full list before this change and still is, consistent with the deliberate decision to leave the export alone.

### Two notes, neither affecting the verdict

1. The spec listed `app/invoices/page.test.tsx` as a new file, but that file already existed at `HEAD~1`. The builder added `app/invoices/page.filter.test.tsx` alongside it instead. The tests described in the spec are present and pass; only the filename differs from the plan.
2. `.gitignore` is modified in the working tree (adding `.playwright-cli/`) but is **not** part of commit `2e036d2` — it was already dirty when I started and is unrelated to this change.

### Limits of this run

Chromium only, per `capabilities.not_exercised`. The export path uses `URL.createObjectURL` and the anchor `download` attribute, so a Firefox- or Safari-specific regression in check 7 would not have been caught here. No sandbox amendment is needed — this is a standing manifest limitation, not something this change introduced, and every check was exercisable as written.
